app.name: Sanguine
taglines: The River of Blood never empties; it only crests.
By blood bound, by brass crowned.
Offerings of bone, rivers of red.
The earth drinks deep, yet the Blood God thirsts.
An ocean of red for the Lord of Rage.

s1.title: Track and understand your cycle
s1.body: Sanguine estimates when your next period and your ovulation are likely, using what you log. Estimates are ranges, not promises. Sanguine is not a contraceptive and is not a medical device.

s2.title: How old are you?
s2.tooYoung: Sanguine is for people aged 13 and over.
s2.ageHelp: Your age sets the starting ranges for estimates. Your date of birth stays on this phone.
s2.invalidDate: Choose a real date of birth.

s3.title: When did your last period start?
s3.emptyNote: No problem. Log your next period to start.
s3.usualLengthInvalid: Enter a number of days from 15 to 90.

s4.title: Anything that affects your cycle right now?

s5.title: Your data stays with you
s5.consent: I understand what Sanguine stores and where.
s5.healthUnavailable: Health import arrives in a later update. Nothing is shared.
s5.backupHint: You can set up an encrypted backup in Settings, under Privacy and data.

onboarding.teenNote: Some features are hidden by default for under 18s. You can change this in Settings.

empty.title: Log your period to start
empty.body: Sanguine needs one period date to begin; two or three cycles make estimates useful.

today.periodLater: Later than usual. Nothing to do yet.
today.suspended: Estimates are paused while “{state}” is set.
today.legend: darker = more likely to be in the fertile window

estimateBasis.combined: Based on several signals you logged.

today.legendFertile: darker = more likely to be in the fertile window

log.title: Log
log.newPeriod: This will start a new period on {date}
log.longPressHint: Press and hold a symptom to change its intensity.
log.noteLocked: Notes are private to this phone.

day.title: {date}
day.joinPrompt: This is within a week of the period that started on {date}. Is it the same period?

a11y.fertile: {word} likelihood of being in the fertile window

backdate.title: Add an earlier period
backdate.body: Pick the first day of bleeding.

insights.title: Insights
insights.empty: Insights appear after two complete cycles.
insights.missedLogPrompt: Was there a period in between?

accuracy.summary: Your 80% ranges have contained the actual date {hits} of {total} times.
accuracy.explain: A range is right about 8 times in 10. A few misses are expected.
accuracy.none: Your accuracy appears after your first completed cycle with an estimate.

insights.confirmLong: No, this cycle was this long
insights.needTwo: Insights appear after two complete cycles.

chart.bandCaption: Shaded: where the next cycle is likely to fall (80%).
chart.coverlineNote: Dashed line: coverline from your temperatures.
chart.phaseCaption: Share of logged days with the symptom, by phase. This is a pattern in your own logs; it never changes an estimate.
chart.noSymptoms: Log a few symptoms to see how they line up with your cycle.

cycleDetail.title: Cycle
cycleDetail.excluded: This cycle is left out of your estimates.
cycleDetail.conflict: The signals you logged did not agree, so the most precise one was used.

lifeState.title: Life state
lifeState.pregnancyEnded: If the pregnancy has ended, choose "Recently gave birth" or "After a pregnancy loss".

effect.paused: Estimates are paused while this is set. Your logs are kept.
effect.warmup: Estimates use general starting ranges for your first three cycles.
effect.wider: Ranges are wider while this is set.

health.title: Health sync
health.unavailable: Health sync arrives in a later update.

privacy.title: Privacy and data
privacy.intro: Your data is stored only on this phone, in an encrypted database. Sanguine has no account and no server.
privacy.exportDesc: A zip with JSON and CSV files.
privacy.importDesc: Sanguine export, Natural Cycles export, or a CSV of period start dates.
privacy.backupDesc: Saves an encrypted file you can keep anywhere.
privacy.appLockDesc: Use Face ID, fingerprint or your passcode to open Sanguine.
privacy.discreetIconDesc: Shows a leaf icon on your home screen. Reminders and widgets say Notes.
privacy.discreetIconDescAndroid: Shows the app as Notes, with a leaf icon, on your home screen. The app closes when this changes; open it again from the home screen.
privacy.screenProtection: Hide the app in screenshots and recent apps
privacy.screenProtectionDesc: On: screenshots and the recent-apps picture are blocked. The recovery code screen always blocks them.
privacy.deleteConfirmBody: This removes every log, setting and backup key from this phone. It cannot be undone.
privacy.importFailed: That file could not be read.

recoveryCode.title: Recovery code
recoveryCode.body: Write this down. Without it and this phone, your backup cannot be opened, by design.

privacy.backupReady: Backup ready. Choose where to keep it.
privacy.restoreCodeLabel: Recovery code (needed on a new phone)
privacy.restoreWrongPassphrase: That passphrase or recovery code does not open this backup.
privacy.restoreNeedCode: This phone has no recovery key. Enter your recovery code.
privacy.restoreBadCode: That recovery code is not valid. Check each word.
privacy.backupNote: Keep the passphrase and recovery code somewhere private. Without them the backup cannot be opened, by design.
privacy.appLockOnly: Turn on a screen lock on this phone first.

notifications.title: Notifications and widgets
notifications.periodSoonDesc: A reminder before your estimated period.
notifications.widgetsDesc: Widgets are available on iPhone for now.
notifications.widgetDetailsDesc: Off: widgets show only the day of your cycle.
notifications.none: No reminder is scheduled yet. Log a period to get estimates.
notifications.denied: Notifications are turned off for Sanguine in your phone's settings.
notifications.androidLater: Reminders on Android arrive in a later update.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.motionNote: Reduced motion follows your phone's setting.

tracking.title: Tracking options
tracking.ovulationEstimateDesc: Turn off to hide ovulation and fertile window estimates.
tracking.teenLocked: Hidden by default for under 18s. You can turn it on here.

about.title: About
about.sourcesDesc: The published studies the estimates are based on.

lock.title: Sanguine is locked
lock.unavailable: No screen lock is set up on this phone.
lock.explain: Sanguine locks when you leave it for a minute. You unlock with Face ID, your fingerprint or your phone's passcode.
lock.off: App lock is off because this phone has no screen lock.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Nothing was lost.
errors.migrationFailed: Could not update the local database.

keyMismatch.title: Your data on this phone cannot be opened
keyMismatch.body: It is locked with a key that only the phone it was created on had. This happens after a phone is restored from a backup. Your history can come back from a Sanguine backup: start again, then restore it in Settings with your recovery code.
keyMismatch.confirmBody: The locked data on this phone is deleted. It cannot be opened without its key, so it cannot be recovered here.
